travel.title: PM Modi Inaugurates Bhogapuram Airport, Andhra Pradesh's First Greenfield Hub
travel.excerpt: The Alluri Sitarama Raju International Airport near Visakhapatnam opens with a 6-million passenger capacity and plans to transform North Coastal Andhra's economic landscape.
travel.nri_angle: The new international airport offers direct connectivity options for the Telugu diaspora, particularly those with roots in Visakhapatnam, Vizianagaram, and Srikakulam districts.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Five Structural Barriers That Keep Foreign Tourists Away From India
travel.excerpt: Despite world-class cultural heritage, India captures just 1.4% of global tourist arrivals — held back by visa friction, steep taxes, scam risks, regulatory red tape, and overtourism at flagship destinations.
travel.nri_angle: NRIs who host visiting friends and family in India regularly encounter these barriers firsthand, from visa headaches to tourist scams and overtourism at popular destinations.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: IndiGo to Discontinue All Widebody Operations, End Norse Atlantic Lease
travel.excerpt: India's largest airline will switch Mumbai-Amsterdam to A321XLR and suspend London Heathrow service until its own Airbus A350s arrive, citing geopolitical disruptions.
travel.nri_angle: Indian travelers in the US and UK face disruptions as IndiGo's ambitious long-haul expansion hits turbulence, with London Heathrow service suspended indefinitely and route changes affecting diaspora travel plans.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Danube Hits Record Lows, Stranding Cruise Ships and Threatening Energy Across Central Europe
travel.excerpt: Europe's second-longest river has dropped to unprecedented levels in Hungary, Serbia, and Romania, forcing cruise cancellations, grounding a Viking ship, and pushing Hungary toward a nuclear plant shutdown.
travel.nri_angle: Indian travelers planning European river cruises this summer face widespread itinerary disruptions and cancellations on the Danube and Rhine.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Cordelia Cruises Eyes Mangaluru as Next Port of Call in Fleet Expansion Push
travel.excerpt: Waterways Leisure Tourism, India's only listed domestic cruise operator, is evaluating New Mangalore Port for future cruise services as it prepares to nearly triple fleet capacity by 2028.
travel.image_caption: New Mangalore Port, which Cordelia Cruises is eyeing as its next port of call for Indian coastal routes.
travel.nri_angle: Cordelia's Indian-centric cruise experience and potential Mangaluru embarkation point offer NRI travellers, especially those with ties to coastal Karnataka, a new way to explore India by sea.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: India's Inbound Tourism Problem: Overseas Marketing Budget Slashed to ₹3.5 Crore
travel.excerpt: India's overseas tourism promotion allocation has collapsed from ₹542 crore in 2019 to ₹3.5 crore in FY27, leaving the country's inbound recovery lagging behind competitors while outbound travel booms.
travel.nri_angle: NRIs who promote India as a travel destination to friends and colleagues find the country lacks the institutional marketing that competing destinations deploy.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: SkyDrive and Suzuki Deepen India eVTOL Push with Kineco Manufacturing Pact
travel.excerpt: Japan's SkyDrive has partnered with Indian composite manufacturer Kineco to build parts for its SD-05 air taxi, adding to Suzuki's growing role in bringing eVTOL technology to Indian cities.
travel.nri_angle: The SkyDrive-Suzuki-India partnership could create new aerospace manufacturing jobs in India and bring air taxi services to congested Indian cities.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Dubai's 'Invite' Scheme Offers $800 in Perks to Revive Post-War Tourism
travel.excerpt: UAE residents who nominate overseas visitors arriving before October 31 can unlock hotel stays, attraction tickets, and dining deals worth over AED 3,000 — part of Dubai's aggressive push to rebuild its tourism brand after the Iran conflict.
travel.nri_angle: Over 700,000 Indian nationals in Dubai can use the programme to bring family from India during peak VFR season, with visa-on-arrival eligibility simplifying the process.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: US Immigration Courts Use 'Mega Master' Hearings to Accelerate Deportation Orders
carousel.excerpt: Courts are scheduling hearings with 100 or more people at a time, up from the typical two or three dozen, as the Trump administration pushes to deport a million people a year.
carousel.nri_angle: The accelerated court proceedings compound fears among documented immigrants, including Indian visa holders, about the broader enforcement climate and due process protections in the US immigration system.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: GSM Foils Chairman Hired Hitmen to Kill Company's Managing Director Over Rs 32 Crore Debt, Police Say
carousel.excerpt: Seven people have been arrested in connection with a murder-for-hire plot targeting the managing director of NSE-listed GSM Foils Limited in Vasai, Maharashtra. The MD survived the shooting and is reported to be stable.
carousel.nri_angle: The case highlights governance risks in India's booming SME stock segment, where NRI investors have increasingly sought higher returns.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Vikrant Massey and Sheetal Thakur: A Bollywood Love Story Written Off-Screen
carousel.excerpt: From meeting on the sets of Broken But Beautiful to building a family together, Vikrant Massey and Sheetal Thakur's relationship has become one of Bollywood's most grounded love stories.
carousel.nri_angle: Vikrant Massey's journey from television to National Award winner resonates with diaspora audiences who followed his rise through OTT platforms popular abroad.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: India's Colombo Warm-Up Match Shortened by a Day Ahead of Sri Lanka Test Series
carousel.excerpt: The four-day practice fixture at the Nondescripts Cricket Club has been cut to three days as India prepare for a crucial WTC series starting August 15 in Galle.
carousel.nri_angle: Indian cricket fans in the diaspora follow Test cricket closely; the WTC standings have direct implications for India's shot at the final.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: NASA Invites Blue Origin to Test New Glenn Rocket at Historic Stennis Space Center After Launch Pad Explosion
carousel.excerpt: The partnership gives Blue Origin access to the Apollo-era B-2 test stand in Mississippi for upper-stage hot-fire testing, as repairs continue at its damaged Cape Canaveral launch complex following a catastrophic May explosion.
carousel.nri_angle: For India's space community watching from ISRO and the private sector, the New Glenn saga illustrates both the difficulty and resilience of heavy-lift rocket development.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: ATF Prices Hiked 3% While Commercial LPG Gets Fifth Straight Monthly Cut
carousel.excerpt: Aviation turbine fuel rises Rs 2,678 per kilolitre as geopolitical tensions push up oil rates, while commercial cooking gas falls Rs 33.50 per cylinder in the August 1 revision.
carousel.nri_angle: Higher ATF prices could translate to costlier domestic and international airfares, affecting NRIs planning trips to India.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk
